newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT - Shuffle Master won't pursue talks.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT - Shuffle Master won't pursue talks.

text.p: Shuffle Master Inc, which provides products for the casino industry, said Monday it does not intend to pursue unsolicited discussions leading to a possible combination with Anchor Gaming. Shuffle Master also said it expects Anchor to challenge Shuffle Master's Let It Ride card game patent.
The following is the text of Shuffle Master's release.

MINNEAPOLIS, Sept. 9 - Shuffle Master, Inc. (Nasdaq-NNM: SHFL) today reported that Stanley E. Fulton, Chairman and CEO of Anchor Gaming, initiated, on an unsolicited basis, discussions with Shuffle Master relating to a potential business combination with Anchor. Shuffle Master does not intend to pursue these discussions.
Shuffle Master believes that Anchor Gaming will now serve Shuffle Master with a lawsuit alleging that Shuffle Master's Let It Ride(R) game infringes certain Anchor Gaming patents.

Shuffle Master's Chairman of the Board, John Breeding, stated, "The Let It Ride game concept is totally unique, which has been demonstrated by its success. Our feeling is that the timing of Mr. Fulton's lawsuit, if served, would be a blatant attempt to pressure Shuffle Master into some form of business arrangement with Anchor Gaming that would clearly be counter to the interests of our stockholders."

Breeding added that, "If Anchor Gaming proceeds to serve a lawsuit upon Shuffle Master, we will immediately seek damages against Fulton and Anchor Gaming based upon claims of unfair competition, abuse of process, punitive damages and other appropriate claims. Shuffle Master may also seek to invalidate Anchor Gaming's patents by filing reexamination proceedings with the United States Patent and Trademark Office alleging invalidity on the basis of obviousness and existing prior art."

Shuffle Master's Let It Ride(R) game is protected by patents validly issued by the United States Patent and Trademark Office. The Company strongly believes that its game infringes no patent and will vigorously defend against any charges of infringement, including those threatened by Fulton and Anchor Gaming.
Shuffle Master, Inc. is a Minneapolis based company that specializes in providing innovative products and services to the casino industry. SOURCE Shuffle Master, Inc.
